rationale: All 14 runs are feasible with room (hold >= 0.038 ns, 0 DRC, <= 324 slew/cap pins), so only T_eff matters. In clean A/Bs AREA 3 beat DELAY 3 (8.92 vs 9.19) and DELAY 4 (8.73 vs 11.59). On the winning backend (TD placement, post-GRT timing and design repair, cap213, util 42), each added step of repair pressure gave small steady gains (8.917, 8.846, 8.785, 8.728); util 48 was worse. Setting 1 takes pressure to the knob limits: target 0.45, both setup margins 0.40 (keeping repair at full effort if re-checked at T_eff). Setting 2 is identical but with stronger slew/cap repair (35/30%), untested with this recipe, using unused headroom.
